flags.issueFull: Brief 014, v3.8 baseline (Brain 5 mirror, 1,000 games per format, same seeds as v3.7): 5v5 changed a lot, 7v7 didn't. At 5v5 the first mover's share of decisive games went from 3.2% to 58.0% (F39's collapse is gone), but games ending on the turn limit went from 35.1% to 61.9%, pull KOs from 44.0% to 23.5%, draws from 1.1% to 6.4%, and the first attack comes on turn 4.4 instead of 2.9. 7v7: every measure within 4 points. Likely the 2-ring deploy area and the 8-hex gap keep Arrow Storm out of early reach, but field and deploy radius changed together: likely, not isolated
flags.next: Recommended: merge v3.8 as the Editor locked it, then fold 5v5 v3.8 into the stall study (brief 016's follow-up) instead of tuning now. If the Editor wants the cause isolated first, one sim-only screen: v3.8 at 5v5 with deployRadius5 = 3 against v3.8, same seeds, 200 games per side. F39 can close if the Editor accepts the field as its fix

flags.issueFull: Brief 014, the hot-seat snap: on a 390 × 844 phone the field view between the top bar and the action panel is 487 px, not the ~590 px the design estimated. The 5v5 field is drawn 1,014 px tall (it fills the width, so its hexes are bigger than 7v7's: 68 px against 54 px), and a side's half (own edge to the middle of the centre row, D9) is 507 px, so after the snap the centre row sits 20 px out of view (49 px to its far edge). 7v7 (449 px), 9v9 (449) and 13v13 (416) fit. Measured in a headless phone browser on this build
flags.next: Recommended: draw the 5v5 field at 7v7's hex size (centred, a margin each side) instead of filling the width; its half becomes about 400 px and fits with room. It changes the 5v5 look, so it needs the Editor's go-ahead. Not built

flags.issueFull: Missing setting (brief 011 settings review, playtest round 2): Brain 5 barely reacts to an enemy's warmed-up special. Of its units inside a warmed special's reach at the start of its turn, only 19% (balanced 7v7) to 46% (5v5) step out, and those that stay are almost never braced (7v7: 102 braced vs 6,053 unbraced). 29–32% of units ending a turn in reach are hit by that special next turn; only 18–68 of those hits land on a braced unit. 400 games per format, specials-playtest-2. Harder to prove than a useless setting: no single example turn was pulled out where bracing or stepping back clearly wins
flags.next: Answered: the Editor said yes (20 Nov). Built in brief 022 (Brain 8) as A2, respect a warmed special; brief 022 closes this row when it merges. Was: Suggested setting: a weight on "end the turn out of a warmed special's reach, or braced inside it", for the unit that special would most likely pick. Needs the Editor's go-ahead (it changes how the bot plays v3.7), then a screen at 200 games per side against the current Brain 5

flags.issueFull: Move order decides balanced 5v5 under specials (v3.7, brief 011). The squad has one Light Ranged a side, and at × 2 Arrow Storm (7 × 2 = 14, no Dodge) kills a full-health Light Ranged (12 HP) from about 7 hexes away (4 of movement, range 3): 1,001 fired, 946 kills in 1,000 Brain 5 mirror games. The second mover, with full Command on turn 1, warms up first and wins the duel: the first mover won 35 of 657 decisive games (5.3%; 38.6% on v3.6). With the older sizes (× 1.5, no kill) it flips: the first mover won 85.3%. 7v7 is far less affected (31.6% vs 46.9%). Fixed bot, same seeds, 1,000 games per format. Likely, not isolated
flags.next: Has a home, no answer needed now (the Editor, 20 Nov): brief 022 runs a sim-only screen (Arrow Storm × 2, × 1.75, × 1.5, and no warm-up on the first turn) with Brain 8 on brief 014's fields, and the sizes are judged there. The design chat's sim check (20 Nov) reads this as mostly the bot walking into the first strike, not Arrow Storm's size (likely, not isolated). Brief 014's baseline (F50) reports the first mover at 58.0% of decisive 5v5 games on v3.8. Code's first recommendation was: Sizes are the Editor's call (brief 011: "not now"). Neither size set fixes it, so the size alone isn't the lever. Recommended: merge v3.7, then run a sim-only screen before choosing a v3.8: Arrow Storm × 1.75 (12.5: kills only a hurt Light Ranged), and the first mover's turn-1 Command at 10 instead of 6 under specials, each against v3.7 on the same seeds
